answer: Randomized live presence roll calls stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent answers a spoken code within five minutes, thrice monthly. Second, answers are checked against voice and timing recorded at signup, so one operator cannot cover many. Third, two failures freeze paid work ninety days and forfeit a $20 bond. Fourth, a clean year unlocks better jobs. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 people on call plus $20,000 in bonds, lost on detection. Trust runs like water through an inlet, is assayed like copper from karst ground, and is earned like a neighbour showing up daily.
